Jennifer Paul is a prophetic painter, singer-songwriter, and an author. She and her husband Joshua make up the team called Celebration State. They are parents to two wildly gifted and intelligent children.  They have served in many levels of ministry over the past 13 years including discipleship, healing, worship, and evangelism. Celebration State released its first album during the Summer of 2020 as a family worship album. It is Celebration State’s belief that everyone who is a son or daughter of God can hear His voice and engage creatively with Him! We hope this video was helpful for you!
